task_groups.title: Implement spec validate structured error output

subtasks.title: Define structured error dataclasses/TypedDicts for schema and integrity errors
details: Create a module or inline dataclasses in spec/validate.py (or spec/cli.py) for structured error types.
SchemaError: category='schema', artifact, path (Optional[str]), message, value (Optional[Any]).
IntegrityError: category='integrity', check, message, requirement_id (and other relevant IDs).
IOError entry: category='io', artifact, message.
Use Python dataclasses or TypedDicts; implement a to_dict() / asdict() method that omits None/empty fields (for 05-REQ-3.E2).

subtasks.title: Update schema validation logic to produce structured SchemaError objects
details: Identify where agentspec/validate runs jsonschema checks; wrap each error into a SchemaError with artifact filename, JSONPath, message, and offending value.
For top-level errors where path is None or empty, omit 'path' and 'value' keys from the serialized dict (05-REQ-3.E2).
Preserve existing validation logic; only change error collection/serialization.

subtasks.title: Update integrity check logic to produce structured IntegrityError objects
details: For each cross-artifact integrity rule (e.g., requirement_coverage), collect failures as IntegrityError objects.
Each IntegrityError must include: category='integrity', check (rule name), message, and relevant IDs (requirement_id, etc.).
Integrate with existing agentspec integrity checks without modifying agentspec library internals.

subtasks.title: Emit validation results using emit/emit_ok and handle IO errors
details: Replace existing click.echo(json.dumps({...})) in validate handler with `emit` or `emit_ok` from agentfox.io.
On success (no errors): emit_ok(valid=True, errors=[])  → exit code 0.
On failure (errors present): emit(valid=False, errors=[e.to_dict() for e in errors]) → exit code 1.
05-ERR-3: catch FileNotFoundError/PermissionError when reading artifact files; emit IOError structured entry with category='io', artifact, message; exit code 1.
Import: `from agentfox.io import emit, emit_ok`.
